System: Chennai Real-Time Flood Forecasting System (CRTFFS) with Real-Time Data Acquisition System (RTDAS)
What it does: Rainfallrunoff and river hydraulic models; streetlevel inundation forecasts on a 2 m DEM
Coverage: About 5,851 sq.km, 4 basins; 117 rain gauges, 30 weather stations, 185 water level recorders, 58 gate sensors
Status: Under implementation by TNDRRA with IIT-Madras and SECON-JBA (World Bank); models validated at Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency of about 0.65–0.74 for the four major reservoirs

What it does: Remote monitoring and operation of reservoir gates
Coverage: 46 gates at Poondi, Chembarambakkam and Puzhal
Status: Commissioned; sanctioned in G.O.(Ms).No.47, WR(S1) Dept., dated 13.03.2024 (Rs.32 crore); decision support and rule-curve logic being added

System: Tamil Nadu Water Resources Information and Management System (TNWRIMS)
What it does: Satellite monitoring of tank storage; HEC-HMS inflow forecasts
Coverage: 14,311 WRD tanks and 73,380 Rural Development tanks; forecasts for 113 reservoirs; 1,213 rain gauge and weather stations
